_phaseKWave20Bishop.notes: Forward-looking SignalR retention dashboard. The W19 lifecycle metrics emit per-tenant applied + cap-triggered counters; the W18 capped counter (signalr_retention_policy_capped_total) is the historical fire count. The W20 replay_expired_total counter is rendered as a neighbouring panel because the auto-expiry CronJob is part of the same retention lifecycle. Wired through Observability/MetricsEndpoint.cs (see Phase K Wave 20 — Bishop comment in that file). The dashboard JSON is COPIED to the build output by Mahjong.Autotable.Api.csproj (the W18 dashboard-copy hook) so the apone-owned infra/ repo can pull it during the W20 fold.

panels.title: Retention applied — rate / 5m
panels.description: Per-tenant rate of signalr_retention_applied. One observation per applied retention sweep (the W19 lifecycle observer). Filterable by tenant.

panels.title: Retention cap-triggered — rate / 5m
panels.description: Per-tenant rate of signalr_retention_cap_triggered. Fires every time the retention sweep observed the configured cap; a sustained non-zero rate indicates either a misconfigured cap or a tenant whose volume is outgrowing the W19 envelope.

panels.title: Retention cap historical fires (W18)
panels.description: Cumulative count from the W18 signalr_retention_policy_capped_total counter. Distinct from the W19 cap_triggered rate above (which is the per-sweep observer); this is the historical fire count carried forward across deploys.

panels.title: Replay auto-expiry — rate / 5m
panels.description: Per-tenant rate of replay_expired_total (W20). The replay auto-expiry CronJob is part of the SignalR retention lifecycle envelope — its fire-rate is rendered alongside the retention metrics so the operator can correlate retention pressure with replay-store eviction pressure.

panels.title: Replay auto-expiry — total fires
panels.description: Cumulative replay_expired_total since process start (W20). Surfaced as a stand-alone stat so the operator can see at a glance whether the auto-expiry CronJob is converging or accumulating.

panels.title: Per-tenant retention activity (last hour)
panels.description: Cross-tenant rollup of applied vs cap_triggered counts over the trailing hour. The operator can sort by cap_triggered to surface the noisiest tenants without filtering the timeseries panels.
